reviews.headline: Average miss 4.97 FanDuel pts across 185 players, about the same as each player's normal game alone (4.94). Over/Under picks went 12 of 20.
right: Over/Under picks hit 12 of 20 (60%), the third straight week at 60% or better.
Wide receivers were the most accurate group (4.6 pt average miss, almost no bias).
missed: Sam Darnold (SEA): projected 11.4, scored 29.7. He threw 2 passes in Week 1 before leaving and missed Week 2, so his share of team passes looked tiny and he was projected for 21 attempts. He threw 45.
QBs were projected 2.2 pts too low on average.
Shedeur Sanders (CLE): projected 14.3, threw 1 pass and scored 0.
Big TD games for Jahmyr Gibbs and Bijan Robinson (8 to 11 pts from TDs each) drove most of the other large misses.
lessons: A game a player leaves early should not shrink their role share when they return as the starter.
Matchup adjustments did not beat the plain normal-game number this week; check whether the defense effect is still worth applying early in the season.
changes: Proposed (not applied yet): skip injury-shortened games when computing a QB's pass share, and backtest the change on 2024, 2025 and 2026 before adopting it.

reviews.headline: Average miss 5.18 pts, better than the normal game alone (5.33). Over/Under picks went 13 of 20.
right: Matchup adjustments helped this week: 0.15 pts better than the normal-game baseline.
missed: Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 24.6 more than projected: 15 pts from TDs on 11 targets (7 projected).
QBs were projected 1.7 pts too low; Josh Allen and Jared Goff each had 10+ pts from TDs above projection.
lessons: Most big misses are touchdown swings, which no projection can call reliably; workload misses are the fixable kind.

reviews.headline: Average miss 6.09 pts, slightly worse than the normal game alone (6.02). Over/Under picks went 12 of 20.
right: Over/Under picks hit 12 of 20 even with no 2026 games to learn from yet.
missed: QBs were projected 3.4 pts too low and RBs 1.9 pts too low.
Caleb Williams, Josh Allen and D'Andre Swift each scored 13 to 14 pts more from TDs than projected.
lessons: Week 1 leans on last season's numbers and is the least accurate week; expect misses to shrink as 2026 games come in.
